text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) can cause common and serious side effects because it works by helping your kidneys remove extra sugar and fluid through your urine.

list.snippet: Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Symptoms include burning when you urinate, frequent or urgent need to go, and cloudy or bloody urine.
Genital yeast infections: Common in both women (vaginal itching, burning, and thick white discharge) and men (redness, itching, or rash on the penis).
Increased urination: Going to the bathroom more frequently or waking up at night to pee. Taking your dose in the morning can help reduce nighttime interruptions.
Increased thirst and mild dehydration: Losing extra fluid can make you feel thirsty.
Upper respiratory tract infections: Mild symptoms like a stuffy nose or sore throat.

text_blocks.snippet: Serious Side Effects (Seek Immediate Medical Care)

list.snippet: Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood that can happen even if your blood sugar is not very high. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, tiredness, fruity-smelling breath, and trouble breathing.
Severe dehydration and low blood pressure: Can cause dizziness, lightheadedness, weakness, or fainting when you stand up. The risk is higher if you take water pills (diuretics) or are 65 or older.

Fournier’s gangrene (necrotizing fasciitis): A rare but life-threatening bacterial infection of the tissue under the skin between the anus and genitals, causing severe pain, swelling, redness, and fever.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): More likely if you take Jardiance alongside insulin or sulfonylureas.
Lower limb amputations: Reported risk of foot or leg amputations, particularly in people with peripheral artery disease or foot ulcers.
Serious kidney infections or damage: Watch for lower back pain, fever, chills, or sudden changes in how much you urinate.
Severe allergic reactions: Swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, hives, or trouble breathing.
